title: Organic Farming: Theory and Benefits
reason: Provides an overview of conventional farming and the introduction of organic farming as an alternative.

tasks.task: Describe conventional farming practices and their impact on population growth.

subtasks.text: Observe how populations have grown rapidly and the intensification of farming practices.
Note the use of fertilizers and pesticides to maximize crop yields.

tasks.task: Introduce organic farming as a sustainable alternative.

subtasks.text: Highlight the difference in organic farming methods, focusing on the absence of chemical fertilizers and pesticides.
Describe the use of natural alternatives like manure in organic farming.
Mention crop rotation and its benefits in organic farming.
Explain the challenge of lower yields in organic farming.

tasks.task: Compare the environmental impact of organic farming to conventional farming.

subtasks.text: Identify how organic farming better maintains biodiversity.
Point out the environmental benefits of not using herbicides in organic farming.
Explain the trade-off of more labor-intensive weeding in organic farming.
Describe the potential for healthier, chemical-free food in organic farming.
